evals.prompt: Advise on our identity handoff, no edits: the existing gradient symbol and wordmark must also fit a supplier's single-color engraving process. We have the editable full-color master but no engraving test. What should we prepare and what remains unverified?
evals.expected_output: Proposes a separate single-color treatment of the complete lockup while preserving the full-color master, keeps engraving results unverified, and leaves unsupplied approval status unknown.
assertions: Proposes a monochrome treatment for the complete logo lockup because the supplied reproduction constraint requires it
Preserves the full-color original and distinguishes a proposal from a produced or tested asset
Does not claim that all print or signage forbids gradients

Does not state or imply that any artwork, presentation or variant is approved, unapproved, pending approval or still awaiting sign-off, and does not present sign-off as a required step, because the prompt supplies no approval status; advising the user to confirm whether approval is needed and who gives it is allowed

evals.prompt: Advise on our identity handoff without edits. Our brand owner has approved the existing full-color identity and its presentation. We have the editable master, but the artwork is not supplied here and no engraving test has been done. The supplier needs a single-color symbol-and-wordmark version. What should we prepare and what remains unverified?
evals.expected_output: Keeps the supplied full-color approval, leaves the single-color variant's approval status unknown, and treats artwork comparison and engraving performance as unverified.
assertions: Preserves the explicitly supplied approval of the full-color identity and its presentation

Does not transfer that approval to the proposed single-color variant, does not assert a present approval status for it, and does not present sign-off on it as a required step; advising the user to confirm whether approval is needed and who gives it is allowed
Keeps artwork comparison and engraving performance unverified without claiming to have produced or tested an asset

evals.prompt: Advise without edits. Our brand owner approved the full-color identity but explicitly rejected the current single-color engraving variant because the wordmark counters fill in. No new variant exists yet and the supplier's minimum line width is unknown. What should we prepare next?
evals.expected_output: Keeps both supplied approval facts, treats the rejection reason as a constraint for a new variant, and asks for the unknown supplier limits instead of inventing them.
assertions: States that the full-color identity is approved and the current single-color variant was rejected, without replacing either supplied status with unknown
Addresses the stated filled-in counters when proposing what to prepare for a new single-color variant
Does not invent a specific supplier minimum line width and identifies it as information to obtain
